authority_notes: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: No campaign-level victory/lose/quest system exists today. The only win flag is FSoulSiegeState.bVictory (SoulCore/Public/SoulSiege.h), scoped to one siege. FSoulObjectiveRules/FSoulBattleObjective (SoulCore/Public/SoulObjectives.h) are tactical/hex-battle only.

VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: Region ownership is the single mutation point FSoulWorldRules::Capture(FSoulWorldState&, RegionId, NewOwner) in SoulCore/Private/SoulWorld.cpp, invoked from USoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem::ApplyBattleResult (SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp).

VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: Canonical factions = FSoulCampaignRules::CanonicalFactions() -> humans,dwarves,orcs,vikings,nature,dark (SoulCore/Private/SoulCampaign.cpp). Factions are FName IDs; there is no faction enum.

VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: 36-region world graph is data-seeded from Data/soul_world_overmap_v1_20260922.json (nodes=36). Canonical campaign-start ownership = Data/soul_campaign_start_state_v1_20260922.json (12 starting possessions, 24 neutral, 2 neutral minor settlements). Founder micro slice = 9 regions, Human vs Orc, locked.

DESIGN PROPOSAL: This schema defines the shape of a NEW canonical FSoulVictoryRules evaluator and its serialized state inside the EXISTING Soul.Campaign RBSave domain. It does NOT create a second save/combat/diplomacy authority.

LOCAL RUNTIME/ASSET CHECK REQUIRED: HUD/banner presentation of objectives and victory uses owned 2D icon packs (see asset_binding section); runtime import of those packs is not confirmed from the cloud.

design_constants.integer_scale_note: All thresholds use integers or permille/millis as mandated by AGENTS.md. No floats.
design_constants.determinism_note: Victory/loss evaluation must be a pure function of serialized campaign state at a well-defined tick (end of ApplyBattleResult and end of AdvanceDay). No RNG, no wall-clock.
design_constants.passive_faction_contract: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT (AdvanceEnemyAI): nature/dark are not driven by autonomous strategic AI in the live loop. DESIGN PROPOSAL: they remain non-victory-seeking obstacle/flavour factions. They can be conquered (counts toward domination) and can hold strategic sites, but they never pursue a victory approach and never trigger an AI-win loss state for the player unless they capture the player's seat in battle (same rule as any faction).

primary_evaluation_points.when: immediately AFTER FSoulWorldRules::Capture mutates ownership and rewards are applied
AFTER FSoulCampaignRules::AdvanceDay, settlement AdvanceDay, hero recovery, other-faction economies advance

fields: FSoulCampaignVictoryState CampaignVictory; // live evaluated state, serialized in Soul.Campaign
note: schema_version in GetRBSaveSchemaVersion_Implementation must bump from 1 -> 2

FSoulVictoryApproach_enum_proposal.justification_for_fifth_approach: LastRealmStanding (seat-elimination) is justified because it is the natural terminal of domination without requiring 100% region sweep, and because the data model already distinguishes faction SEATS (control_class=starting_possession, seat_region in start state) from ordinary regions. It gives a decisive, verifiable end that AI and player share. See campaign_progression_v0_v2.md 'Why five approaches'.

victory_conditions.label: Military Domination
victory_conditions.intent: Hold an overwhelming share of the 36-region map and the enemy seats.

parameters_v0_founder_slice.note: Founder micro slice (9 regions) uses the already-shipped condition: capture orc_camp (enemy_primary_region). This is VERIFIED behaviour today via ApplyBattleResult capturing the target region; V0 only adds an explicit flag read, not new mechanics.

parameters_v1_six_faction.rival_seats_source: Data/soul_campaign_start_state_v1_20260922.json factions[*].seat_region for every faction with any starting_possession != player
parameters_v1_six_faction.comment: Owning 60 permille of 36 = 22 regions AND holding every rival seat. Nature/dark seats count if those factions still own them.

parameters_v2.comment: V2 lets federated/vassal seats count as controlled, lowering the raw-conquest bar when diplomacy is used.

victory_conditions.label: Alliance / Federation
victory_conditions.intent: Bind the surviving playable realms into a durable federation under the player rather than conquering them.

parameters_v1.status: DESIGN PROPOSAL depends on Lane 4 Diplomacy V1 / vassalage; V0 ships this as LOCKED/visible-but-unavailable.
parameters_v1.comment: At least 3 playable factions (incl. player) at Peace with RelationPermille >= 750 continuously for 10 days, and no playable faction at War with the player. nature/dark are excluded from the federation count (passive).

victory_conditions.dependency: Lane 4 (prisoners/Diplomacy V1). This condition MUST read the same HumanRelations ledger; it must NOT create a second diplomacy authority.

victory_conditions.label: Magical Supremacy
victory_conditions.intent: Dominate the arcane layer: control the shrines/arcane sites and field a maxed arcane settlement + high-tier mage hero.

parameters_v1.arcane_site_source: Data/soul_world_overmap_v1_20260922.json nodes where feature in [ancient_shrine, shrine]
parameters_v1.comment: Hero level/spells read from FSoulHeroState (Level, KnownSpells). Arcane building operational via FSoulSettlementRules::IsOperational. Shrine control via region ownership.

victory_conditions.label: Economic / Site Control
victory_conditions.intent: Win through sustained economic dominance: hold the strategic resource/trade sites and a maxed market/mine network, accumulate a treasury threshold.

parameters_v1.strategic_site_source: overmap nodes with feature in [quarry, resource, crossroads, trade_road, river_crossing] + neutral_minor_settlements from start state
parameters_v1.comment: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: treasury is Economy.Resources['gold']; human.market L>=2 operational grants +100 gold/day today (AdvanceDay). Gold threshold is DESIGN PROPOSAL pending Lane 9 economy model.

parameters_v2.depends_on: Lane 9 recommended_costs_and_income.csv for the final gold threshold and site income values

victory_conditions.dependency: Lane 8 (strategic sites) for the authoritative site list; Lane 9 (economy) for gold/income thresholds. Do NOT hard-code the site list here beyond what overmap features already prove.

victory_conditions.label: Last Realm Standing
victory_conditions.intent: Terminal domination: every rival playable faction has lost its seat (eliminated).

parameters_v1.comment: A playable faction is 'eliminated' when it owns zero of its original starting_possessions AND zero other regions. nature/dark are ignored for this condition (passive).

parameters_v2.comment: V2: a fully vassalized playable faction counts as not standing (removed as a rival), enabling a diplomacy-assisted terminal.

state_inputs: starting_possessions per faction from start state

loss_conditions.label: Capital Lost
loss_conditions.rule: Player owns zero regions among the player's starting_possessions AND zero other regions.

loss_conditions.label: Hero Lost
loss_conditions.rule: DESIGN PROPOSAL: NOT a hard loss. Per baseline (hero wound/capture solved) and Lane 3 'avoid routine permanent death', a captured/wounded primary hero is a setback, never an instant game over. Only becomes a loss trigger if hero is Captured AND player seat is also eliminated (compound).

loss_conditions.label: A Rival Has Won
loss_conditions.rule: Any rival playable faction meets military_domination OR last_realm_standing against the field including the player's seat captured. DESIGN PROPOSAL: not active in V0 because AdvanceEnemyAI is inert; becomes meaningful only once strategic AI (Lane 2) drives expansion.

capital_recovery_grace.rule: On seat loss, enter RECOVERY. Player retains hero(es) and any field army. If the player recaptures ANY region (not necessarily the original seat) within grace_days, RECOVERY clears and campaign continues. If grace_days elapse with zero owned regions, the loss becomes final.
capital_recovery_grace.comment: Keeps parity with hero wound/capture recovery already modeled via FSoulHeroRules::AdvanceRecovery.

hero_recovery.note: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: FSoulHeroRules::AdvanceRecovery already decrements RecoveryDays each AdvanceDay for Wounded/Captured heroes. Victory layer only READS Hero.Condition; it does not re-implement recovery.

campaign_victory_state_serialization.restore_location: USoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem::RestoreRBSaveDomain_Implementation reads 'victory'; absent => default (back-compat with schema 1 saves)

fields.name: ActiveApproachMask
fields.meaning: approaches currently enabled for this scenario

fields.name: SustainStartDayByApproach
fields.meaning: day a sustained condition first became true; 0 if currently false

fields.name: EndgameEscalationDay
fields.meaning: day endgame modifiers activated; 0 if not escalated
